newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate end up, market awaits Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate end up, market awaits Greenspan.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates ended up 75 basis points at 19.50 percent on Monday.
Dealers said rates came under mild pressure on uncertainty ahead of testimony by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan to a congressional panel on Tuesday and Wednesday.
"Rates did not jump sharply, rather they were reluctant to fall. They were under pressure and could remain so tomorrow due to Greenspan's testimony," a fixed-income analyst said.
The analyst added that dealers saw little point in acquiring paper during the session as "you never know with Greenspan."
